scripts.refreshRecruitPresentation:
local v = ctx.v

v.candidateRoster = {
    {
        name = v.candidateName or "?",
        level = v.candidateLevel or 1,
        hp = v.candidateHp or 0,
        maxHp = v.candidateMaxHp or 1,
        spriteKey = v.portraitKey,
    }
}

local mpd = v.mpdDelta or 0
if mpd > 0 then
    v.upkeepText = "+" .. tostring(mpd) .. " shared MP drain per battle round."
elseif mpd < 0 then
    v.upkeepText = tostring(math.abs(mpd)) .. " less shared MP drain per battle round."
else
    v.upkeepText = "No additional shared MP drain."
end

local function rosterLine(index, member)
    if not member or member.empty then
        return tostring(index) .. ".  -- Empty --"
    end
    return tostring(index) .. ".  " .. (member.name or "?")
        .. "\n    HP " .. tostring(member.hp or 0)
        .. "/" .. tostring(member.maxHp or 0)
end

local activeLines = {}
local reserveLines = {}
for index = 1, 4 do
    activeLines[index] = rosterLine(index, api.party(index))
    reserveLines[index] = rosterLine(index, api.reserve(index))
end
v.activeSummary = table.concat(activeLines, "\n")
v.reserveSummary = table.concat(reserveLines, "\n")

local slotIdx = v.slotIdx or 1
local isReserve = slotIdx > 4
local slot = isReserve and (slotIdx - 4) or slotIdx
local occupant = isReserve and api.reserve(slot) or api.party(slot)
if occupant and occupant.empty then occupant = nil end
local rosterName = isReserve and "RESERVE" or "ACTIVE"
v.destinationTitle = rosterName .. " SLOT " .. tostring(slot)
    .. ": " .. (occupant and occupant.name or "Empty")

if not occupant then
    v.destinationEffect = isReserve
        and "The candidate joins the expedition reserve."
        or "The candidate joins the fielded party."
elseif not isReserve then
    local emptyReserve = nil
    for reserveSlot = 1, 4 do
        local reserveMember = api.reserve(reserveSlot)
        if not reserveMember or reserveMember.empty then
            emptyReserve = reserveSlot
            break
        end
    end
    if emptyReserve then
        v.destinationEffect = occupant.name .. " moves to Reserve slot "
            .. tostring(emptyReserve) .. "."
    else
        v.destinationEffect = occupant.name
            .. " moves to Town Storage if space is available."
    end
else
    v.destinationEffect = occupant.name
        .. " moves to Town Storage if space is available."
end

v.confirmText = (v.candidateName or "The candidate") .. " will take "
    .. rosterName .. " slot " .. tostring(slot) .. ".\n" .. v.destinationEffect

content.text: {v.showOnboarding and 'A creature has answered the rite.' or ((v.mode or 1) == 1 and 'A creature waits at the threshold of the rite.' or 'Choose its place among those already bound.')}

{v.upkeepText}

Terms are checked on confirm.
Nothing changes before placement.

[Confirm] accept   [Cancel] leave

windows.title: DESTINATION
windows.visible: not v.showOnboarding and ((v.mode or 1) == 2 or v.mode == 3)

windows.title: ACTIVE PARTY
windows.visible: not v.showOnboarding and (v.mode == 2 or v.mode == 3) and v.slotIdx <= 4

windows.title: ACTIVE PARTY
windows.visible: not v.showOnboarding and (v.mode == 2 or v.mode == 3) and v.slotIdx > 4

windows.title: RESERVE
windows.visible: not v.showOnboarding and (v.mode == 2 or v.mode == 3) and v.slotIdx > 4

windows.title: RESERVE
windows.visible: not v.showOnboarding and (v.mode == 2 or v.mode == 3) and v.slotIdx <= 4

content.text:
A recruited creature must be given a place in the expedition.

Choose an Active slot to field it, or a Reserve slot to keep it nearby. If a chosen slot is occupied, that creature moves safely to Reserve or Town Storage.

[Confirm] continue
